note: Generated by design/tools/traits.py. GAME_DESIGN 7.3: elites and their twelve traits. Looks: design/look.md sections 3 and 4.

elite.note: An elite is a species of the Track's roster made dangerous: one body the player has to deal with on purpose. World units; factors multiply the species' own numbers (design/species.json).
elite.who: any species of the Track's roster except Shoal darts and Wyrm segments (a Wyrm's head may be elite: its chain follows)
elite.drops: one Cell, whatever the players' health (GAME_DESIGN 6.1), and its Shards
elite.coop: health x (1 + 0.5 x (players - 1)), as mini-bosses and bosses
elite.look: look.md 3: hull + 0.6, 2.3 px, a white copy of the hull, glass, an aura at 0.22; a white edge chevron while it is off screen; never dimmed by the light budget
elite.arrival: warps in like any enemy but from 90 wu and with the elite's low fifth (root and fifth of the Track's key); its trait's mark sounds a beat later

when.pace: the director buys an elite with the threat budget about once in 16 bars in Track 3, falling evenly to once in 8 bars by Track 6 and staying there; never in a Break, a boss fight or a mini-boss fight

alive.note: at most this many at once, for all players together; no elite before Track 3 (the key keeps its name)

traitsCarried.loop: one more for each time round, to four at most
traitsCarried.note: drawn by the seed from the traits the run has met; never two that hide (Cloaked and Phasing) on one body

traits.name: Armored
traits.effect: health x 2 again. While its outer hull holds (the first half of its health) shots spark off it without the hit flash; at half health the outer hull shatters and it is an ordinary elite

traits.name: Swift
traits.effect: moves at 1.6 times its speed and turns 1.3 times as fast

traits.name: Giant
traits.effect: 1.8 times the size (on top of the elite's 1.3), health x 2.5, cannot be shoved; its death is a large kill

traits.name: Splitting
traits.effect: when it dies two copies leave it, 0.6 of its size, each with 30% of its health and no trait; they do not split again

traits.name: Volatile
traits.effect: its death is a bomb with a warning: a danger ring of 160 wu fills over two beats and bursts on the beat, taking a cell from any ship inside and dealing 30 x the Track's number to every enemy inside (other Volatiles go off in turn)

traits.name: Regenerating
traits.effect: after two beats without being hit it heals 8% of its health on every beat

traits.name: Shielded
traits.effect: its front 120 degrees sheds every shot; it turns to keep the shield on the nearest player at 1.2 radians a second

traits.name: Twin
traits.effect: arrives as two bodies with one health bar (x 1.6): damage to either counts for both, they keep 200 to 300 wu apart, and they die together
traits.mark: the fifth again, a beat later

traits.name: Magnetic
traits.effect: steals loose Shards within 300 wu, up to forty; they orbit it, and its death releases them doubled

traits.name: Commander
traits.effect: enemies within 400 wu of it move 30% faster; when it dies they are stunned for one beat
traits.mark: a snare roll of one beat

traits.name: Cloaked
traits.effect: drawn at 8% between beats and in full on each beat's flash (the 110 ms envelope); it can be hit at any time, and whatever it fires is on the priority layer as always

traits.name: Phasing
traits.effect: solid only in the first half of each beat: in the second half shots pass through it and its touch does not hurt
traits.mark: the fifth, gated on the eighths
